annotations.title: Look up a state's property tax rules

description: How property tax actually works in one state: how assessed value is derived, any statutory growth cap, the billing cycle, named exemptions such as homestead, the filing deadline, who hears appeals and the window to file, notable county variation, and a link to the state's own tax authority. Use this when the question is about mechanics or deadlines rather than a dollar amount.

inputSchema.description: Property tax mechanics, exemptions, appeal windows and county variation for one state.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

name: get_state_mortgage_rules

outputSchema.description: Property tax rules and reference data for one US state.

averageEffectiveTaxRatePercent.description: Average effective property tax rate, as a percentage.

countyVariation.description: How rates vary by county, each with a name and note.

dataAsOf.description: Date the underlying data refers to.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

distinguishingFeature.description: What sets this state's system apart.

estimatedAnnualTaxOnMedianHome.description: Estimated annual tax on the median home, in dollars.

exemptions.description: Available exemptions, each with a name and detail.

lastReviewed.description: Date the entry was last reviewed.

nationalAverageRatePercent.description: National average rate, as a percentage.

officialSource.description: The state's own tax authority reference.

rankHighestToLowest.description: Rank of the state's rate, 1 being highest.

url.description: Page about the state on this service.

title: Look up a state's property tax rules
